variants.name: lined-purple
variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided app icon ONLY by replacing its colors. STRICTLY preserve all original geometry, composition, exact relative positions, stroke widths, corner radii, document silhouette, fold shape, proportions, margins, and all existing details. Do NOT redesign, simplify, add, remove or move anything. Replace every cobalt blue region with solid #663DE8; replace every mint/teal region with solid #C2ADFF; keep every white region white. Preserve the TWO document text strokes and blue fold cutout, recoloring them to the new background color; four scanner corners become the accent color. Flat 2D, uniform solid fills, crisp edges. Same square full-bleed framing. No gradients, texture, shadows, text, labels, mockup or watermark. Return ONLY the recolored icon.
